en.headline: Australian CFA non-permanent judge William Gummow dies aged 83
en.dek: The Hong Kong Judiciary and legal bodies expressed deep sadness at the passing of the former High Court of Australia justice who sat on the Court of Final Appeal since 2013.
body: The Honourable Mr Justice William Montague Charles Gummow AC, a Non-Permanent Judge of the Court of Final Appeal, has died at the age of 83, the Judiciary announced.

Mr Justice Gummow was appointed as an NPJ of the CFA in 2013. He sat on the court on many occasions, most recently in May 2026, and authored important judgments that greatly enriched Hong Kong jurisprudence, the Judiciary said in a statement issued on 17 September.

Born in Australia in 1942, he earned degrees from the University of Sydney, practised as a solicitor then barrister, and served on the Federal Court of Australia from 1986 before joining the High Court of Australia from 1995 to 2012. He was appointed a Companion of the Order of Australia in 1997.

The Hong Kong Bar Association and the Law Society of Hong Kong also expressed deep sorrow and extended condolences to his family, noting his contributions across constitutional, administrative, criminal, trust and tax law.

zh.headline: 終院非常任法官甘慕賢逝世 享年83歲
zh.dek: 司法機構及法律界對澳洲籍終審法院非常任法官甘慕賢辭世深表哀悼，他自2013年起出任終院非常任法官。
body: 司法機構公布，終審法院非常任法官甘慕賢（William Montague Charles Gummow）逝世，享年83歲。
甘慕賢於2013年獲委任為終審法院非常任法官，多次審理案件，最近一次在2026年5月。司法機構表示，他撰寫的重要判詞大大豐富本港法理。
甘慕賢1942年在澳洲出生，於悉尼大學取得文學及法學碩士學位，先後出任律師及大律師，1986年加入澳洲聯邦法院，1995至2012年出任澳洲高等法院大法官，1997年獲頒澳洲同伴勳章。
香港大律師公會及律師會亦對其辭世深表哀悼，並向其家人致以慰問，指他對憲制及行政法、刑事法、信託法及稅務法等範疇貢獻良多。
